L13·N93unmasked layer
This neuron fires on short function/filler words that are *unexpected* completions of a phrase ("if it is **not** immediately announced", "**Good** luck", "no Europe **or** no Europe", "to **go** away", "appears to **help**"), and is strongly suppressed on the highly predictable next word inside fixed collocations ("carried **out** by", "number **of**", "discouraged them **from**", "skeptical about **a** law…") — i.e. it tracks low- vs. high-predictability at grammatical-word positions rather than any single lexical item.

L27·N8140unmasked layer
This neuron is almost exclusively negative-valued: it goes most strongly negative on ordinary function-word/punctuation tokens inside flowing prose — especially the comma closing a sentence-initial adverbial phrase right before a subject proper noun ("As a result, Vysionics", "In her free time, Doris") and linking words like "to" — while it relaxes toward zero on tokens that introduce a capitalized personal name or title (" P." Barry, " Claire" Lane, " T"ittle), i.e. it tracks generic connective prose rather than any semantic category.
